en.title: 40% faster customer complaint handling in telecom with GenAI

sections.title: Client background
paragraphs: The client manages a highly sophisticated satellite network and connectivity infrastructure, ensuring seamless coverage for customers worldwide.
Published client profile: Industry: Telecom. Partnership period: January 2021 - present.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client sought to streamline the processing of multilingual customer support logs to improve issue identification, assess support quality, and accelerate problem resolution. By leveraging generative AI and Large Language Models (LLM), the company aimed to automate various processes, eliminate manual tasks, and reduce troubleshooting time and costs, ultimately enhancing service quality and boosting customer satisfaction.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team helped the client develop a solution that utilizes two fine-tuned LLMs to generate summaries from multilingual customer support chat logs, displayed through an intuitive dashboard.

The first model provides a comprehensive summary of the customer conversation, highlighting the main issue and potential resolution. The second model filters out irrelevant requests to ensure only relevant data appears in the dashboard. Both models support multiple languages (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese) and provide English translations.

Additionally, the models automatically classify chat logs into predefined topics and a set hierarchy. Paired with the dashboard, the solution allows the client to efficiently search, filter, and analyze customer feedback for specific services, significantly reducing manual effort and enabling the team to focus on higher-priority business tasks.
The new genAI solution comprises the following architecture components:
Apache Airflow serves as a job orchestration tool.
Amazon EMR runs queries against the source table and stores the results in Amazon S3.
Amazon SNS is automatically triggered when a file lands in S3, then invokes a Lambda function.
The Lambda function triggers batch transform jobs, powered by Amazon SageMaker.
Amazon SageMaker provides model hosting, deployment, and inference.
The output data is stored in Amazon S3.
The Tableau report is generated based on the output data.
A Docker image is created for the Sagemaker transform job processing and hosted on Amazon ECR.
All Sagemaker logs are stored in AWS CloudWatch.

sections.title: Value delivered
paragraphs: The AI solution enables the client to identify and mitigate issues faster. By leveraging generative AI to summarize customer support requests automatically, the client has accelerated troubleshooting by up to 40%.
The solution also offers advanced data analytics capabilities, allowing the client to process vast amounts of data within minutes and make effective, timely decisions.
Moreover, the AI solution automatically translates support logs from Spanish and Portuguese into English, making it easier for the client to provide top service to customers worldwide.

Expertise delivered:
Generative AI development services
Technologies:
Apache Airflow, Amazon EMR, Amazon S3, Amazon SNS, Amazon SageMaker, Tableau, Amazon ECR, AWS CloudWatch, Docker

sections.title: خلفية العميل
paragraphs: يدير العميل شبكة أقمار صناعية وبنية اتصال متقدمة توفر تغطية للعملاء حول العالم. وتشير الدراسة إلى بدء الشراكة في يناير 2021.

sections.title: تحدّي الأعمال
paragraphs: استهدف العميل تبسيط معالجة سجلات الدعم متعددة اللغات لتحديد المشكلات وتقييم جودة الدعم وتسريع الحل. وسعى باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي والنماذج اللغوية الكبيرة إلى أتمتة المهام وتقليل العمل اليدوي ووقت التشخيص وتكاليفه، بما يحسن الخدمة ورضا العملاء.

sections.title: التنفيذ
paragraphs: طوّر فريق التنفيذ حلًا يعتمد على نموذجين لغويين مضبوطين لتلخيص محادثات الدعم وعرضها في لوحة سهلة الاستخدام. يلخّص النموذج الأول المحادثة والمشكلة الرئيسية والحل المحتمل، ويستبعد الثاني الطلبات غير ذات الصلة. يدعم النموذجان لغات منها الإسبانية والبرتغالية ويقدمان ترجمة إنجليزية.
يصنّف الحل المحادثات تلقائيًا إلى موضوعات وبنية هرمية محددة، ويتيح البحث والتصفية وتحليل ملاحظات العملاء حسب الخدمة، لتقليل الجهد اليدوي والتركيز على الأولويات.

تتكون المعمارية من Apache Airflow لتنسيق المهام، وAmazon EMR للاستعلام عن البيانات وحفظها في S3. يؤدي وصول ملف إلى S3 إلى تشغيل SNS ثم Lambda التي تبدأ مهام التحويل الدفعي في SageMaker، المسؤول عن الاستضافة والنشر والاستدلال. تحفظ المخرجات في S3 وتُعرض في تقارير Tableau. تُجهّز صورة Docker للمعالجة وتُستضاف على ECR، وتُحفظ السجلات في CloudWatch.

sections.title: القيمة المتحققة
paragraphs: ساعد التلخيص الآلي في تحديد المشكلات ومعالجتها أسرع، مع تسريع التشخيص حتى 40%. وأتاح تحليل كميات كبيرة من البيانات خلال دقائق واتخاذ قرارات في الوقت المناسب.
تترجم السجلات تلقائيًا من الإسبانية والبرتغالية إلى الإنجليزية، لدعم خدمة العملاء عالميًا.
الخبرة: تطوير الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي. التقنيات: Airflow وEMR وS3 وSNS وSageMaker وTableau وECR وCloudWatch وDocker.

Dosyanın gelişi SNS ve Lambda’yı tetikler; Lambda, barındırma, dağıtım ve çıkarım sağlayan SageMaker toplu dönüştürme işlerini başlatır. Çıktı S3’e yazılır ve Tableau raporuna aktarılır. Docker işleme imajı ECR’de, günlükler CloudWatch’ta tutulur.

en.title: 115% revenue growth in healthcare with modernized digital solutions

sections.title: Client background
paragraphs: The client helps improve and facilitate clinical trials and studies by providing software solutions that help determine research data quality, accuracy, and integrity. The company has over 10 years of experience and a global clientele.
Published client profile: Industry: Healthcare and Life Sciences. Partnership period: December 2020 - present.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client aimed to modernize their Big Data monitoring platform that analyzes clinical and operational data during trials and detects atypical data patterns (tempering, systemic errors, fraud, etc.). They wanted to re-architecture the solution to make it more scalable and flexible and enhance its functionality with new integrations and additional features. This would help improve the service quality of the client’s solution, help them attract new customers, and grow revenue.

sections.title: Delivery approach
paragraphs: The delivery team assisted the client in designing a new, highly scalable infrastructure for the monitoring solution and all its additional features. The delivery team assessed the client’s existing architecture, which included comprehensive analyses of the monitoring solution, the administration platform, and the risk-based oversight application. During this assessment, the delivery team engineers:
Helped design the new architecture;
Analyzed data storage systems;
Identified challenges in the existing data architecture;
Determined business needs and requirements, such as migration to the cloud, data storage and management standardization, pre-production and production testing automation, and others.
Finally, the engineers helped the client conduct code refactoring and utilize a data-centric architecture approach while developing new microservices-based solutions.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team helped the client re-architecture the monitoring platform, making it more scalable and allowing it to process larger volumes of data quickly and efficiently. The delivery team implemented a microservices-based Data Storage service and set up a data pipeline that ingests, processes, and transports data in the following stages:
Conversion of csv files to the Parquet format, which resulted in faster data transfer and reduced storage costs.
Transformation of data written in Python and SAS into a Parquet file, which is easier to analyze.
Creation of dataset snapshots which store data in various formats for several applications.
Storage of datasets on Azure blob storage instead of MySQL, which resulted in high scalability of the solution in terms of the amount of data it can store and the rate at which data can be accessed.

Data from the Data Storage service is rendered in the new medical study and review platform that the delivery team engineers helped develop. This platform contains interactive dashboards and charts that display insights on each clinical study. It allows data analysts to filter trial details by various attributes, leave comments, and assign reviewers to conduct deeper data analysis.

Furthermore, the delivery team helped automate the process of creating data cubes, which represent and analyze data across different characteristics, such as patient ID, region, country, etc. As a result, this accelerated the data analysis setup from approximately 2 hours to just under 3 minutes per customer.

The delivery team also helped automate action item generation for cases when data anomalies are detected. Instead of manually inspecting data and creating action items for deviations, customers can simply set up and configure specific thresholds. If data crosses the set threshold, the system automatically generates notifications to the customer’s CRM and ERP systems. This accelerated data anomaly detection from several days to just minutes.

Next, the delivery team assisted the client with manual and AQA testing of third-party integrations and system UI, as well as the setting up of new tools. Our AQA engineers helped unify automation tests across the monitoring platform and optimize end-to-end automation test cases. This reduced the test automation lifecycle from 24 to 3 hours and achieved a 90% test automation pass rate.

Moreover, the delivery team helped design and implement a performance testing solution that can launch multiple tests with different scenarios on numerous environments at the same time. This included implementing a single test reporting tool for all QA teams, which provides analytics for all unit tests and aggregates and compares results on a daily, weekly, or quarterly basis.

Together with the client, the delivery team implemented automated regression testing for multiple solution environments. The delivery team set up testing for system migration to a separate environment, which allowed us to verify changes in the database and architecture components without disturbing other environments, manual testing, or the development process.

Finally, the delivery team helped the client build a new separate administration platform, which was originally part of the monitoring platform. The delivery team migrated all its features from the monitoring platform, such as user and study management. The delivery team also established effective synchronization between the two systems.

sections.title: Value delivered
paragraphs: The delivery team helped the client re-architecture the monitoring platform, which included providing a comprehensive architecture assessment, implementing and integrating new features and tools, and setting up automation tests. The delivery team also helped develop a separate medical study and review platform, and an administration platform. As a result of the engagement, the client gained several substantial benefits:
Increased customer base and engaged a Fortune Global 500 company by enhancing their services with a new monitoring platform that offers a wide range of useful features;
Grew their revenue by 115% in 2023 alone as a result of the increase in customer base;
Improved platform performance by up to 14.5 times by utilizing cloud-native features for storing data and applying a data-centric approach that allows the platform to be scaled easily.

Expertise delivered:
Software QA & Testing, Big Data, DevOps consulting
Technologies:
Python, Angular, MS Azure, Flask, Pyramid, FastAPI, Celery, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLAlchemy, Cypress, Kubernetes

أعاد الفريق هيكلة الكود واعتمد معمارية تتمحور حول البيانات عند تطوير حلول الخدمات المصغرة.

طُور اختبار أداء يشغّل سيناريوهات متعددة بالتوازي في بيئات مختلفة، مع أداة تقارير موحدة تجمع نتائج اختبارات الوحدات وتقارنها يوميًا وأسبوعيًا وربع سنويًا.
نُفذت اختبارات رجوع آلية لعدة بيئات، واختبار ترحيل في بيئة مستقلة للتحقق من تغييرات قاعدة البيانات والمعمارية دون تعطيل التطوير والاختبارات الأخرى.
بُنيت منصة إدارة منفصلة، ونُقلت إليها وظائف إدارة المستخدمين والدراسات مع مزامنة فعالة مع منصة المراقبة.

paragraphs: İzleme çözümü, yönetim platformu ve risk temelli gözetim uygulaması değerlendirildi. Yeni mimari tasarımı, depolama analizi, mimari zorluklar ve buluta geçiş, veri standardizasyonu ile üretim öncesi/üretim testi otomasyonu gereksinimleri belirlendi.
Kod yeniden düzenlendi ve mikroservis çözümlerinde veri merkezli mimari benimsendi.

Farklı uygulamalar için veri anlık görüntüleri üretildi ve MySQL yerine Azure Blob’da saklandı.

Çoklu ortam için regresyon otomasyonu ve ayrı taşıma testi kuruldu; veritabanı ve mimari değişiklikleri geliştirme ile diğer testleri bozmadan doğrulanabildi.
Kullanıcı ve çalışma yönetimi ayrı bir yönetim platformuna taşındı ve izleme sistemiyle senkronize edildi.

en.title: Comprehensive security assessment for a leading AI brand protection platform

sections.title: Client background
paragraphs: The client helps businesses protect themselves from online threats with a wide range of brand protection services. In particular, they utilized cutting-edge technologies such as machine learning to safeguard against piracy, brand abuse, etc.
Published client profile: Location: Europe. Industry: Insurtech. Partnership period: February 2017 - present.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client’s automated software applications analyze vast amounts of data to identify counterfeit products, unauthorized use of images, and other infringements online. They aimed to make these applications faster and more accurate while ensuring they could efficiently handle increasing amounts of data. Furthermore, the company needed to ensure that there were no security vulnerabilities in these applications that could be exploited to hinder their performance.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team performed a comprehensive security assessment of the client’s applications, analyzing their external interfaces and business logic implementation and focusing on security flaws, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations. The delivery team provided actionable recommendations based on our analysis that helped the client strengthen their security posture. The specialists conducted penetration testing using the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide checklist to ensure comprehensive coverage of all web security aspects.

In addition, the delivery team helped the client migrate their applications from Java to Python to ensure more efficient data scraping and processing. The delivery team also developed several new applications to cover more marketplaces and emulated human-like behavior to make their detection more difficult.

Finally, the engineers helped improve the efficiency of the client’s applications by utilizing several Python optimization techniques. This ensured they could process large amounts of data with minimal resource usage.

sections.title: Value delivered
paragraphs: The client partnered with the delivery team to perform comprehensive security assessments and optimizations of their automated brand infringement analysis applications. As a result, the client gained several substantial advantages:
Acquired a comprehensive security report of their applications with identified vulnerabilities and actionable recommendations on how to mitigate them;
Enhanced the speed and accuracy of their applications, allowing them to identify and remove counterfeit products and unauthorized content in real time;
Improved the ability of their applications to cover a wider range of online platforms, such as marketplaces, social media, websites, etc.

en.title: Platform re-architecture into microservices for a leading media licensing company

sections.title: Client background
paragraphs: The client is a global leader in licensing various types of media, such as video, music, images, and custom content tailored to brand needs.
Published client profile: Industry: Media & Entertainment. Partnership period: June 2019 - present.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client aimed to facilitate the maintenance, customization, and addition of new features to their web and admin platform. To achieve this, they wanted to re-architecture the monolith-based backend of these platforms.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team helped the client re-architecture a massive monolithic architecture into microservices to make the web and admin platforms easier to maintain and customize. The delivery team utilized the serverless approach for the architecture, eliminating the need to maintain servers and enabling the client to use the pay-as-you-go model. After successfully developing a PoC of the Transition microservice using Nest.js, the delivery team applied its TypeScript-based framework for microservices related to user identity, subscription, and online sales.

Additionally, the delivery team engineers helped implement a Single Sign-On multi-factor authentication and a social login for the client’s products. The delivery team also helped improve subscription management by decoupling a massive legacy Subscription module into smaller and more flexible microservices, such as Rebilling, Adjustment, and Transition.
Finally, the delivery team helped the client develop Promotions and Product APIs to facilitate the management of promotional activities.

sections.title: Value delivered
paragraphs: By re-architecting the web and admin platforms with the delivery team, the client gained several substantial advantages:
Streamlined the development, testing, maintenance, and customization of the web and admin platforms with new microservices-based architecture;
Reduced maintenance costs by utilizing the serverless approach to architecture design.

Software Engineering, Back-end Development
Technologies:

en.title: Digital acceleration in retail with solutions for supply chain management

sections.title: Client background
paragraphs: The client is a prominent global fashion retailer with tens of thousands of employees operating in thousands of stores across the globe.
Published client profile: Industry: Retail. Partnership period: October 2019 - present.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client wanted to streamline their supply chain, logistics, and material management by unifying all processes in a single modern platform. They wanted to make it easily accessible from both the web and mobile. Furthermore, the company aimed to build the platform quickly with the ability to scale it to suppliers and customers.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team helped the client develop the supply chain visibility and raw material management modules for the client’s new management platform.

The supply chain visibility module allows tracking supplier information in the supply chain. It consists of a web and an iOS application that offer comprehensive and user-friendly visualization of various supplier data, including:

Single representation view for examining the entire list of suppliers and their details. It provides tables, charts, and historical dashboards that visualize tier levels, markets, social traceability rankings, etc. It also includes a convenient filtered search feature.

Production view for monitoring changes over time in ordered and supplied materials during specific seasons. It allows checking the number of produced units or the quantity of manufactured raw materials and elements supplied for specific client departments.
Related suppliers view for viewing dashboards with visualization of hierarchy tiers, supplier collaboration, and market distribution.

Ranking and performance view for monitoring social and environmental ranking for suppliers, such as energy consumption. It also enables creating supplier improvement plans and tracking of how these criteria change over time.
Corporate information view for keeping track of supplier contacts, locations, and tax information.

The client’s employees can use the iOS application to easily add new suppliers using a QR code on their devices. Also, the engineers helped set up the testing process for the supply chain visibility module from scratch, covering more than 90% of the code with unit tests, and more than 80% with integration tests.

Additionally, the delivery team helped the client develop an MVP version of the raw material management module. It allows the client’s buyers (employees responsible for ordering raw materials for production) to see a detailed overview of all their purchases, enabling effective raw material management. The delivery team helped implement a key feature—KPIs of raw materials that outline the number of ordered materials that can be used for production and the number of expected deliverables. It improves buyers’ decision-making and ensures timely material availability for production.

sections.title: Value delivered
paragraphs: By developing some of the key modules for the new supply chain management platform, the delivery team helped the client acquire several important advantages:
Streamlined supply chain management with a comprehensive and detailed view of all suppliers;
Improved operational efficiency by ensuring that the new platform has the required features and capabilities to handle thousands of users and suppliers;
Ensured effective raw material management and decision-making with a comprehensive overview and KPIs of all purchases.

Mobile App Development, Software QA & Testing, Software Engineering, MVP Development
Technologies:

العرض الموحد يجمع الموردين وتفاصيلهم في جداول ورسوم ولوحات تاريخية تظهر المستويات والأسواق وتصنيفات التتبع الاجتماعي مع بحث مفلتر. عرض الإنتاج يتتبع تغير المواد المطلوبة والموردة حسب الموسم والوحدات المنتجة والمواد المخصصة للأقسام. عرض الموردين المرتبطين يوضح المستويات والتعاون والتوزيع الجغرافي.

يضيف الموظفون الموردين عبر رمز QR في تطبيق iOS. أُنشئت عملية الاختبار من الصفر، بتغطية تتجاوز 90% لاختبارات الوحدات و80% للتكامل.
طُورت نسخة MVP لإدارة المواد الخام تمنح المشترين نظرة شاملة إلى المشتريات. تعرض مؤشرات المواد المطلوبة والقابلة للإنتاج والتسليمات المتوقعة لدعم القرار وتوافر المواد في وقتها.

Üretim görünümü sezonluk sipariş ve teslim malzemesi değişimlerini ve bölüm bazında üretilen birimleri izler. İlişkili tedarikçiler görünümü hiyerarşi, iş birliği ve pazar dağılımını sunar.
Performans görünümü enerji tüketimi gibi sosyal/çevresel dereceleri, iyileştirme planlarını ve değişimleri takip eder. Kurumsal görünüm iletişim, konum ve vergi bilgilerini tutar.

Hammadde MVP’si alıcılara tüm satın alımları gösterir. Sipariş edilmiş ve üretimde kullanılabilir malzemeler ile beklenen teslimat KPI’ları kararları ve zamanında tedariki destekler.

sections.title: Sağlanan değer

paragraphs: The client is a prominent company known for designing, manufacturing, and retailing stylish undergarments and sleepwear for both men and women. They operate across several European countries and holds a leading position in its regional market.

sections.title: Business challenge
paragraphs: The client aimed to improve the speed and efficiency of their product manufacturing lifecycle. The company wanted to leverage AI and 2D/3D-modeling to streamline the clothing testing (prototyping) process.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: The delivery team engineers investigated several AI and ML-based models, defined their strengths and weaknesses, and helped the client choose the model best suited to their needs. The solution analyzes sketches of clothes prepared by a designer and the set body parameters required for testing. Based on this data, it generates a 2D or 3D model of how the product would fit on a person.
